{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash

# Flux batch script
#
# This is a self-submitting Flux script: run it directly (e.g., `./cabbeling.flux.sh`).
# It will submit itself to Flux with the translated resource requests.

# Translated resources from PBS:
#   -l ncpus=12        -> -n 1 -c 12
#   -l ngpus=1         -> -g 1
#   -l walltime=24:00:00 -> -t 24h
JOBID=$(flux batch -N 1 -n 1 -c 12 -g 1 -t 24h --wrap "bash $0 __flux_inner")

echo "Submitted Flux job: $JOBID"

if [ "${1:-}" = "__flux_inner" ]; then
  # NOTE: PBS -q gpuvolta not translated.
  # Performance implication: without a queue/constraint mapping, the job may run on any eligible GPU resources; you are not forcing the gpuvolta queue.

  # NOTE: PBS -P e14 not translated.
  # Performance/ops implication: accounting/charging may not be applied as intended; site may require project/account out-of-band.

  # NOTE: PBS -l mem=96GB not translated.
  # Performance implication: without a memory reservation/limit, the job may contend for memory or be OOM-killed, affecting reliability/performance.

  # NOTE: PBS -l jobfs=1GB not translated.
  # Performance implication: without local scratch reservation, temporary I/O may be slower or run out of space.

  # NOTE: PBS -l storage=gdata/e14+scratch/e14 not translated.
  # Performance implication: if storage placement/quotas matter, I/O performance/availability may differ.

  # NOTE: PBS -l wd and $PBS_JOBID are PBS-specific.
  # Performance implication: none; operational implication: we use current directory and Flux job id for logging.

  # NOTE: PBS -M (email) not translated.
  # Performance implication: none; operational implication: no email notifications.

  cd /g/data/e14/jb2381/CabbelingExperiments/ || exit 1

  export JULIA_DEPOT_PATH="/home/561/jb2381/.julia"
  export JULIA_NUM_THREADS=auto
  module load julia

  JOBTAG=${FLUX_JOB_ID:-job}

  flux run -n 1 -c 12 -g 1 julia --project isothermal_gpu_salinitynoise.jl > "${JOBTAG}.log"
fi
"
}
